summary: The legal input contains at most 100 toggle operations over exactly 100 bulb states, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation scans each operation once and then scans the fixed state array.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= bulbs.length <= 100, with every bulb number from 1 through 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one constant-time boolean negation for each of at most 100 operations and then inspects exactly 100 fixed bulb states, establishing O(N) time across the complete legal workload bound.

The certificate regression checks all 488,280 arrays over bulb numbers 1 through 5 at lengths 1 through 8, deterministic legal arrays at every length through 100, and explicit lower-, upper-, and complete-domain boundaries against an odd-frequency oracle.
